articles.title: Ethereum Institutional signals support for Ethlabs’ motion to reduce Ethereum block times
articles.description: The non-profit signaled support for reducing Ethereum block times, citing increasing institutional activity moving onto the smart-contract network.

articles.title: HYPE hits record above $90 as Hyperliquid launches manual borrowing
articles.description: HYPE hit a record $90.92 after Hyperliquid opened manual borrowing, letting users borrow stablecoins against HYPE and Bitcoin collateral.

articles.title: Dragonfly’s Qureshi calls for end to Zcash dev fund after 2028
articles.description: Industry watchers are debating the fate of the Zcash development fund after the ZEC token’s rally pushed its value above $95 million.

articles.title: Bitcoin adds to bull-market hopes as price metric prints fourth-ever bullish cross
articles.description: The Fisher Transform indicator produced a rare crossover for only the fourth time in Bitcoin’s history.

articles.title: Stablecoin payments firm dtcpay closes $25M round with SBI backing
articles.description: Dtcpay plans to expand its merchant network and payment products after completing a $25 million Series A backed by Japan’s SBI Group.

articles.title: Binance brushes off Lagarde MiCA speculation, reaffirms Europe commitment
articles.description: Binance declined to address reports of ECB intervention in its Greek MiCA bid, saying it remains committed to securing authorization in Europe.

articles.title: Bitcoin cycle bottom may already be in at $58K, says analyst James Check
articles.description: Onchain analyst James Check says Bitcoin may have bottomed near $58,000 after two capitulations and warns against anchoring to an October low.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Zcash targets November for NU7 mainnet upgrade with 25-second blocks
articles.description: NU7 will cut Zcash block times to 25 seconds and preserve its halving schedule, with testnet activation planned for Oct. 6.

articles.title: Cardano’s IOG warns users to avoid YouTube channel amid apparent hijack
articles.description: Input Output Group told users to avoid its YouTube channel after it began livestreaming a suspected AI-manipulated Charles Hoskinson video promising to “double your wealth.”

articles.title: World launches self-custodial ‘super app’ World Money
articles.description: World Money is rolling out across more than 150 countries, combining stablecoin payments, digital asset rewards and trading in a self-custodial app.

articles.title: US sanctions Iran’s BitBank, saying it processes ‘Hormuz Safe’ Bitcoin payments
articles.description: US Treasury says the Iranian exchange processed payments received through Iran’s Strait of Hormuz maritime scheme and helped move hundreds of millions of dollars in Bitcoin to the IRGC.

articles.title: North Korea drives onchain malware surge, CoinEx shuts: Asia Express
articles.description: North Korea and Iran account for the majority of onchain malware, while Malaysia has been named among the most crypto curious Islamic nations.

articles.title: CFTC expands regulatory relief for passive trading software providers
articles.description: The US regulator’s move could make it easier for crypto wallets and other apps to offer access to regulated derivatives and prediction markets without registering as introducing brokers.

articles.title: WisdomTree, MoonPay team up to expand US access to tokenized money market fund
articles.description: MoonPay plans to use WisdomTree’s $1.2 billion WTGXX tokenized fund as part of its stablecoin reserves while helping expand access to US investors.

articles.title: Is there any chance left to save the CLARITY Act?
articles.description: CLARITY isn’t dead after failing a key Senate vote, but with time running short and Democrats still demanding changes, its path forward is narrowing.

articles.title: Bitcoin coils near $76.5K as US stocks rebound from Fed rate hike
articles.description: Bitcoin made modest daily gains as US stocks saw upside in the aftermath of the US Federal Reserve’s first interest-rate hike since July 2023.

articles.title: Zcash miner Fortitude taps former Hut 8 CEO to lead ahead of public listing
articles.description: Former Hut 8 CEO Jaime Leverton will take the helm at Fortitude as the Zcash-focused miner expands its operations and moves toward a planned public listing.

articles.title: OG.com cleared by SEC to offer single-stock futures, says Crypto.com CEO
articles.description: Crypto.com’s CEO said its sister exchange was cleared to offer US access to single-stock perpetual futures, as the latest platform to bridge TradFi and digital assets.

articles.title: SEC grants temporary exemption for tokenized US stock trading
articles.description: The SEC’s Innovation Exemption allows limited tokenized US stock trading on onchain venues with trading caps and transparency requirements.

articles.title: Bitcoin treasury firms can outperform BTC... but is the risk worth taking?
articles.description: Bitcoin treasury companies promise to amplify returns over investing in Bitcoin alone, but does the potential upside outweigh the risks to the downside?

articles.title: S&P Global to acquire blockchain security platform OpenZeppelin
articles.description: S&P Global agreed to buy OpenZeppelin, which says its smart contracts have facilitated more than $37 trillion in value transfers.

articles.title: Crypto adoption blooming in Germany, while UK is falling ‘behind,’ says CoinShares researcher
articles.description: German crypto adoption is progressing through family offices and wealth managers, while the UK’s retail-facing cryptocurrency market remains “nascent,” according to the researcher.

articles.title: State hackers drive 420% surge in onchain malware, Chainalysis finds
articles.description: North Korea-linked hackers used Tron, Aptos and BNB Chain to maintain malware infrastructure, while suspected Iran-linked actors embedded directions in Bitcoin transactions.

articles.title: Zcash gains 20% as Paradigm founder reveals firm made ZEC investment
articles.description: Zcash rose about 20% in 24 hours as Paradigm co-founder Matt Huang disclosed that the firm invested in ZEC amid a broader crypto market rally.

articles.title: Revolut says no direct contact from hackers after $3M public ransom demand
articles.description: Revolut says it received no direct contact despite separate ransom demands for $3 million in Monero and 10,000 Bitcoin from competing breach claimants.

articles.title: Polymarket users referred to prosecutors in South Korea: Report
articles.description: South Korean police reportedly referred 18 Polymarket users to prosecutors in a gambling probe involving 26 people and $12.7 million in bets.

articles.title: Bitcoin treasuries buy just 5.9K BTC in three months as paper losses linger
articles.description: Bitcoin corporate treasuries remained at an unrealized loss on their holdings as the price fell below $80,000 and fresh capital inflows dwindled.

articles.title: BitMEX faces Celsius lawsuit ahead of exchange closure
articles.description: The Celsius estate alleges BitMEX wrongfully liquidated and seized 6,360 BTC, worth nearly $490 million, during the March 2020 market crash.

articles.title: OpenAI discloses 6 new cases of ‘misaligned’ AI behavior
articles.description: The six cases are separate from July’s incident, when OpenAI models escaped containment and hacked Hugging Face during a security evaluation.
